text: Blackmail rarely works effectively and can backfire against the police in libellous action and so bad publicity.
text_raw:
Blackmail rarely
works effectively and can backfire against the police in libellous action and so bad
publicity.

text: Bribe never works, despite the fact that a volunteer may be offered money and protection in exchange for information.
text_raw:
Bribe never works, despite the fact that a volunteer may be offered money and
protection in exchange for information.

text: He should bear in mind that when he is of no further use to the police they drop him and the protection means nothing, for example, Kenneth Lennon.
text_raw:
He should bear in mind that when he is of no
further use to the police they drop him and the protection means nothing, for example,
Kenneth Lennon.

text: While being tortured in a brutal, physical manner it is important that a volunteer should consolidate his position, he should realise that it's seven days if he keeps silent, perhaps seventeen years if he speaks.
text_raw:
While being tortured in a brutal, physical manner it is important that a volunteer should
consolidate his position, he should realise that it's seven days if he keeps silent, perhaps
seventeen years if he speaks.

text: It's no easy thing to dismiss physical torture as a small or meaningless thing.
text_raw:
It's no easy thing to dismiss physical torture as a small or
meaningless thing.

text: It is by no means small and by no means meaningless to the receiver.
text_raw: It is by no means small and by no means meaningless to the receiver.

text: From time immemorial, from histories recorded as far back as the Babylonian Empire up through the days of Imperial Rome, from the Spanish Inquisition to Nazi Concentration Camps, Free State and British police stations, come stories of how people coped and defeated the attempts of police to beat information from prisoners.
text_raw:
From time immemorial, from histories recorded as far back as the Babylonian Empire up
through the days of Imperial Rome, from the Spanish Inquisition to Nazi Concentration
Camps, Free State and British police stations, come stories of how people coped and
defeated the attempts of police to beat information from prisoners.

text: One notable technique was the prisoners’ ability to form images in their minds or on the surrounding walls.
text_raw:
One notable technique was the prisoners’ ability to form images in their minds or on the
surrounding walls.

text: People who were brutalised found that by directing their powers of concentration away from their interrogators and diverting it to images formed in their own mind they could in effect overcome the physical pain.
text_raw:

concentration away from their interrogators and diverting it to images formed in their
own mind they could in effect overcome the physical pain.

text: Some people pictured images in their own mind or in the mind's eye, this picture may have been a flickering candlelight, a leaf
text_raw:

text: Court Martial Procedure.
text_raw: Court Martial Procedure.

text: A Court-martial is set up by the O/C of any Unit or by the C/S to try any Volunteer on a specific charge or charges.
text_raw:
A Court-martial is set up by the O/C of any Unit or by the C/S to try any Volunteer on
a specific charge or charges.

text: The Court shall consist of three members of equal rank or higher than the accused.
text_raw: The Court shall consist of three members of equal rank or higher than the accused.

text: The Convening Officer will appoint one member of the Court as President.
text_raw: The Convening Officer will appoint one member of the Court as President.

text: IRA Green Book
text_raw: IRA Green Book

text: When a Court-martial is set up by a Unit O/C, the Adjutant of the Unit, or some member of the Unit delegated by the Adjutant of the Unit to do so, will act as Prosecuting Counsel.
text_raw:
When a Court-martial is set up by a Unit O/C, the Adjutant of the Unit, or some
member of the Unit delegated by the Adjutant of the Unit to do so, will act as Prosecuting
Counsel.

text: When the Convening Authority is the C/S, he may appoint any officer other than the Adjutant General to act as Prosecution Counsel.
text_raw:
When the Convening Authority is the C/S, he may appoint any officer other
than the Adjutant General to act as Prosecution Counsel.

text: The accused may call on any Volunteer to act as his defence Counsel, or, if he so desires, may defend the case himself.
text_raw:
The accused may call on any Volunteer to act as his defence Counsel, or, if he so
desires, may defend the case himself.

text: A copy of the charges shall be supplied to the accused in reasonable time before the case is heard to enable him to prepare his defence.
text_raw:
A copy of the charges shall be supplied to the accused in reasonable time before the
case is heard to enable him to prepare his defence.

text: The Convening Authority may either supply the accused with a summary of the evidence it is proposed to place before the Court, or arrange for a preliminary hearing at which the witnesses for the prosecution will give oath, a summary of their testimony.
text_raw:
The Convening Authority may either
supply the accused with a summary of the evidence it is proposed to place before the
Court, or arrange for a preliminary hearing at which the witnesses for the prosecution will
give oath, a summary of their testimony.

text: At such preliminary hearing, neither defence nor prosecution counsel will be present, but the accused may cross-examine the witnesses.
text_raw:
At such preliminary hearing, neither defence nor
prosecution counsel will be present, but the accused may cross-examine the witnesses.

text: The evidence shall be taken down in writing from each witness, shall be read over to him and signed by him.
text_raw:
The evidence shall be taken down in writing from each witness, shall be read over to him
and signed by him.

text: If the accused wishes to make a statement or give evidence on oath he must be cautioned that anything he says may be taken down and used in evidence, at any subsequent hearing of the case.
text_raw:
If the accused wishes to make a statement or give evidence on oath he
must be cautioned that anything he says may be taken down and used in evidence, at any
subsequent hearing of the case.

text: If the accused objects to any of the three officers comprising the Court, his objection will be examined by the remaining two members, and if upheld, the member objected to will be replaced.
text_raw:
If the accused objects to any of the three officers comprising the Court, his objection
will be examined by the remaining two members, and if upheld, the member objected to
will be replaced.

text: The Convening Authority will ensure that the Prosecuting Counsel is in possession of all the facts relevant to the case and that all prosecution witnesses are present at the Court.
text_raw:
The Convening Authority will ensure that the Prosecuting Counsel is in possession of
all the facts relevant to the case and that all prosecution witnesses are present at the
Court.

text: The Convening Authority will supply the Court with a copy of the charges and with copies of General Army Orders.
text_raw:
The Convening Authority will supply the Court with a copy of the charges and with
copies of General Army Orders.

text: During the hearing of the case, all witnesses will be kept in a separate room as in the case of a Court of Inquiry.
text_raw:
During the hearing of the case, all witnesses will be kept in a separate room as in the
case of a Court of Inquiry.

text: The only persons present in the Court shall be members of the Court, the accused, the defence Counsel (if any) and the witness under examination.
text_raw:
The only persons present in the Court shall be members of the
Court, the accused, the defence Counsel (if any) and the witness under examination.

text: The oath will be administered as in the case of a Court of Inquiry.
text_raw: The oath will be administered as in the case of a Court of Inquiry.

text: At the start of the case, the President will read each case to the accused and ask him if he pleads guilty to the charge.
text_raw:
At the start of the case, the President will read each case to the accused and ask him if
he pleads guilty to the charge.

text: Witnesses when called to testify will be cross-examined first by the Prosecuting Counsel and then by the Defence Counsel, or by the accused if conducting his own defence.
text_raw:
Witnesses when called to testify will be cross-examined first by the Prosecuting
Counsel and then by the Defence Counsel, or by the accused if conducting his own
defence.

text: Witnesses may be questioned by any member of the Court.
text_raw: Witnesses may be questioned by any member of the Court.

text: Should either Counsel wish to recall a witness who has already testified, permission of the Court must first be obtained.
text_raw:
Should either
Counsel wish to recall a witness who has already testified, permission of the Court must
first be obtained.

text: The Court may recall any witness.
text_raw: The Court may recall any witness.

text: Witnesses may not leave the precincts of the Court without permission from the Court.
text_raw:
Witnesses may not leave the
precincts of the Court without permission from the Court.

text: IRA Green Book
text_raw: IRA Green Book

text: At any time it so desires, the Court may go into private session to decide on points which may arise, such as the admissibility of evidence.
text_raw:
At any time it so desires, the Court may go into private session to decide on points
which may arise, such as the admissibility of evidence.

text: When all witnesses have testified, Defence Counsel will sum up and make closing address to the Court.
text_raw:
When all witnesses have testified, Defence Counsel will sum up and make closing
address to the Court.

text: This will be followed by summing up and closing address of the Prosecuting Counsel.
text_raw:
This will be followed by summing up and closing address of the
Prosecuting Counsel.

text: The Court then goes into private session to consider its verdict and sentence.
text_raw:
The Court then goes into private session to consider its verdict and
sentence.

text: For breach of any General Army Order, the Court shall not have power to impose a lesser penalty than that laid down in such order.
text_raw:
For breach of any General Army Order, the Court shall not have power to impose a
lesser penalty than that laid down in such order.

text: The verdict and sentence of the Court shall be set down in writing and signed by the three members.
text_raw:
The verdict and sentence of the Court shall be set down in writing and signed by the
three members.

text: This, together with a summary of the evidence, must be forwarded by the President to the Convening Authority.
text_raw:
This, together with a summary of the evidence, must be forwarded by the
President to the Convening Authority.

text: Sentence is subject to the ratification of the Convening Authority.
text_raw:
Sentence is subject to the ratification of the
Convening Authority.

text: Note:
text_raw: Note:

text: In the case of the death penalty, sentence must be ratified by the A/C.
text_raw:
In the case of the death penalty, sentence must be ratified by
the A/C.

text: The accused may forward an appeal against the verdict or sentence or both to the Adjutant-General who will place it before the Competent Authority.
text_raw:
The accused may forward an appeal against the verdict or sentence or both to the
Adjutant-General who will place it before the Competent Authority.

text: The appeal should be forwarded by accused through his O/C. who in return will forward it to the Adjutant- General with a signed copy of verdict and sentence and a summary of the evidence.
text_raw:
The appeal should
be forwarded by accused through his O/C. who in return will forward it to the Adjutant-
General with a signed copy of verdict and sentence and a summary of the evidence.

text: The Competent Authority may order a new trial or reduce the penalty but may not increase the penalty imposed by the Court.
text_raw:
The
Competent Authority may order a new trial or reduce the penalty but may not increase
the penalty imposed by the Court.
